2610.13767.title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
2610.13767.paper_summary: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.
2610.13767.paper_summary_zh: 低位元推理在具有原生4位元支援的加速器上需要對權重和激活進行量化，以實現這些格式所提供的全部吞吐量增益。雖然後訓練權重量化已被廣泛研究，但激活量化仍然相當具有挑戰性，通常需要校準數據。在這項工作中，我們介紹了DUALQUANT，一個雙尺度、無需校準的後訓練量化框架，該框架直接最小化權重重建均方誤差（MSE），並作為直接副產品，在激活量化之前產生每通道的激活重新縮放。我們的關鍵觀察是，通過最小化權重重建誤差獲得的縮放因子提供了有效的激活重新縮放，使得在沒有校準數據的情況下能夠進行具有競爭力的激活量化。我們將DUALQUANT公式化為一個不可微分的權重重建問題，並基於變量分割和區塊坐標下降開發了一個高效的求解器，其中每個子問題都允許閉合形式的更新。DUALQUANT提供了一個統一的算法，支持廣泛的格式，包括完整的MX系列和NVFP4。據我們所知，DUALQUANT是第一個正式支持MX和NV區塊格式的雙縮放方法。在對WikiText-2、C4和零樣本下游任務進行評估的Llama和Qwen模型中，DUALQUANT在大多數模型和格式中匹配或超過基於校準的SmoothQuant的準確性，並顯著超越無校準基準，對MX和NV區塊格式有著巨大的增益。我們通過在RTX 4090上對Llama-3.1-8B進行實際打包的W4A4推理路徑來驗證這些增益。最終實現的準確性與假量化的準確性非常接近，同時在內存減少上達到高達2.61倍，吞吐量加速高達2.46倍，相比於BF16。
